queries.name: one day
queries.sql: SELECT amount FROM orders WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-15'

queries.name: last 7 days (open range)
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-10-24'

queries.name: closed range
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-15'

queries.name: BETWEEN
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-10' AND DATE '2026-09-19'

queries.name: IN list
queries.sql: SELECT status FROM orders WHERE order_date IN (DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-03', DATE '2026-10-05')

queries.name: OR of two days
queries.sql: SELECT amount FROM orders WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01' OR order_date = DATE '2026-10-20'

queries.name: OR with another column (no pruning)
queries.sql: SELECT amount FROM orders WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01' OR amount > 99

queries.name: no partition filter
queries.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

queries.name: SELECT * one day
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-30'

queries.name: filter pushed through a CTE
queries.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM orders) SELECT customer_id, amount FROM o WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-10-28'

queries.name: join with partition filter
queries.sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-10-25' GROUP BY c.region

queries.name: filter-only column
queries.sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'open' AND order_date = DATE '2026-10-10'

queries.name: EXTRACT on partition column
queries.sql: SELECT amount FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) = 9
